title: Client Partner, Acquisitions DACH
searchText: Client Partner, Acquisitions DACH Reddit Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 121 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . The Mid-Market international team is responsible for building the international ads engine outside of the US, onboarding & growing advertisers to achieve their marketing objectives with proven solutions and at pace globally. Last year we launched our sales team in Amsterdam that is focused on growing our Mid-Market business in DACH. This is an opportunity for you to be part of the team that expands the Reddit footprint: design the strategy, develop a strong book of business, and bring the magic of Reddit into the DACH market! We're looking for a sharp, positive and motivated self-starter to help us build this team! New Business Client Partners will be responsible for seeking out new high-potential clients and building the foundation for mutually beneficial, long-term partnerships by aligning your clients' company goals with opportunities on the Reddit ads platform. In person attendance at our Amsterdam office is required. Core Responsibilities: Identify and reach out to new clients, establishing mutually beneficial relationships and educating them on Reddit and the Reddit ads platform Act as the CEO of your book of business, and take full ownership of strategic bets, revenue forecasting, and ensuring operational rigor Work with Sales Ops Lead to develop a book of business and outbound sales pipeline Communicate feedback on our sales processes, narratives, and products in order to advocate for customers and improve the team's effectiveness and efficiency Collaborate with Account Managers to build mutually beneficial partnerships between your customer base and Reddit Qualifications: 6+ years of relevant experience in online media sales (platform experience preferred) Strong understanding of the media landscape and broad network of clients in DACH Have relevant experience using New Business tools such as Zoominfo, LinkedIn, Salesforce etc. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets, strong negotiation skills, and ability to build and maintain client relationships Experience with and passion for new business acquisition with proven equivalent work experience Motivated self-starter who thrives in unstructured environments Users-first orientation Positive outlook, team player Fluent in German and English Benefits: Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Private Pension plan with Employer-matching 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan Income Replacement Programs Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. Reddit is a community of communities.
